manifest.title: SCENT! AI 조향사 · 전체 화면 리디자인
manifest.scope: 행사·팝업용 본인 사진 분석, 퍼퓸10ml 고정, 기본 카메라, QR 대안, 입력5단계, 결과3장, 자동 첫 영수증 출력
notes: 목업 제안이며 앱 코드 및 운영 설정은 변경하지 않았습니다.
별도 출력 완료 화면은 기존 완료 토스트를 개선한 UX 제안입니다.
최초 레시피 출력은 결과 화면 CTA에서 자동 요청하며 확인을 한 번 더 받지 않습니다.
manifest.bottleRequirement: All perfume bottles are completely plain: no text, logo, icon, volume marking or label.

prompts.title: 시작·프로필·키보드
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create an exceptionally polished, production-quality Korean portrait touchscreen kiosk UI design board for "SCENT! AI 조향사", the event/popup PERSONAL PHOTO perfume-recipe experience. This is NOT the WOW idol store service. No product selection or checkout. Perfume is fixed at 10ml.
COMPOSITION: Exactly THREE complete equal portrait 9:16 screen canvases side-by-side on a very narrow pale grey gutter. Overall landscape aspect about 1.72:1. Aim for high resolution around 3072x1800 so Korean remains readable. Flat front-facing UI exports, full screen from header through fixed footer, no device housing, perspective, shadows surrounding screens, page captions, decorative presentation title or extraneous fourth screen.
VISUAL SYSTEM: warm ivory #F5F3ED full canvas, ink #172324 typography, vivid cobalt #244EEA primary actions, muted periwinkle #E8ECFF selected tile backgrounds, warm clear/amber glass and silver perfume materials. Beautiful tactile photographic glass perfume motif with refracted blue light. Elegant large tightly spaced editorial serif SCENT! brand wordmark paired with large crisp Korean sans-serif headings and readable Korean body. Restrained fine rules, generous negative space, modest 20px corner radii at1080px canvas, consistent typography and alignment. Refined contemporary perfume atelier identity. Avoid desktop windows, pixel art, retro chrome, dashboard clutter, AI robot illustrations and excessive floating cards.
KIOSK USABILITY: each screen has small top "SCENT!  AI 조향사", home outline icon, "한국어 ⌄"; clear stage indicator for 5 input steps, large readable title, large touch targets, a fixed spacious footer with secondary "이전" and full cobalt primary action, aligned at exactly same height across all panels. Minimum conceptual button size96px at1080px width. Text and buttons must not overlap or be cropped.
Use ONLY accurate short Korean copy supplied, plus sparse English labels. No gibberish, fabricated prices or technical implementation notes. Results use a fictional sample person "서연"; camera portrays the same fictional adult Korean woman age28, shoulder-length black hair, simple white top, natural approachable face, no celebrity likeness. The matching example is AC’SCENT No.02 "만다린 오렌지", notes TOP 만다린 오렌지 / MIDDLE 그레이프프루트 / BASE 피오니. Display no unsupported accuracy guarantee.

BOARD 01 — START / PROFILE / TOUCH KEYBOARD. Exactly three different screens.
LEFT START: top small "AI PERFUMER". Very large elegant ink "SCENT!" wordmark aroundupperfifth with cobalt exclamation mark, followed by Korean "AI 조향사". Main headline "지금의 나," then "어떤 향이 어울릴까요?". Hero: beautifully lit real slender 10ml glass perfume atomizer with brushed silver cap, subtle blue refracted glass circular object and a white scent blotter, on ivory seamless background. Art occupies middle third with ample white space. Below concise "사진 한 장으로 만나는 나만의 향". Three tiny numbered labels "취향 선택  ·  사진 촬영  ·  향 레시피". At bottom full cobalt button "나의 향 찾기  →", quiet label "퍼퓸 10ml 조향 체험". No small explanatory walls of text.
CENTER PROFILE: stage "01 / 05  나를 소개해요", headline "어떻게 불러드릴까요?", description "향 레시피에 담길 이름을 알려주세요." Main large underlined/card input label "이름 또는 별명 · 선택", text "서연". Next field "성별" with three large horizontal choices "남성" "여성" "기타"; 여성 selected pale cobalt fill and check. Under input tasteful small perfume and name-tag vignette in large negative space. Footer "이전" / "다음  →".
RIGHT KEYBOARD: identical profile design upper part, stage01, same "어떻게 불러드릴까요?" and active name field "서연|" selected cobalt outline, all3genderchoicesvisible above. Bottom half occupied by generous Korean touchscreen keyboard, four clean rows, familiar Korean 2-beolsik keys, "한/영", "공백", backspace, wide cobalt "입력 완료". Keyboard never obscures name. This is a distinct input interaction state. Keep card framing and top header identical to center.
